scope: Synthetic release test-harness assessment, excluding prebuilt raw source input. These are evaluation gates, not new production scheduler limits.
basis: The 14-workload pilot measured at most 10,511,371 transient live bytes, 11,561 result bytes, and zero bytes retained after teardown. Use 32 MiB transient headroom and a 256 KiB result cap. Recheck changed workloads; do not call this a desktop idle-memory bound.
